Attributes

Abilities

  • "Flame On!"
    Plasma generation/fire manipulation. Jules is able to kinda sorta control the speed of particles around him to light his body aflame. However, the coldest he can make himself is his regular body temperature.
  • "Supernova!"
    Maximum effort! This is what he shouts if he's putting his plasma generation into overdrive.
  • Superhuman durability, agility, equilibrium and endurance
  • Pyrokinetic flight
    Well, if there's a serious wind blowing and Flint's in sand form, she can fly… kind of. More like gliding, really.
  • Heat manipulation
  • Temperature resistance

Equipment

  • Fire retardant costume
    So the clothes don't burn off. Specially made by Reed Richards. It can kind of withstand Supernova.

  • Favorite food goes here.
  • Surprisingly good at singing.
  • Smells vaguely like gasoline all the time due to his abilities.
  • Doesn't shower or brush his teeth unless it's to relieve stress because he doesn't need to. …He just burns all the germs and bacteria off of him each day. Discloses this to no one.
